user.title: Connect Homebears
user.description: Create a personal API key in the Homebears app under Settings → API keys. Give it `shopping:write` for the shopping lists, `cleaning:write` for chores and `households:read` so this setup can list your households.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless you run your own Homebears server.
data_description.api_key: Starts with hb_. It is shown only once when you create it.

circle.title: Choose a circle
circle.description: This key reaches several circles. Each circle is added as its own entry.

select.title: Choose what to show
select.description: Each shopping list becomes a to-do list and an open-items sensor; each household gets a sensor with the chores open today.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {circle} no longer works (revoked, expired or replaced). Create a new one in the Homebears app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Homebears. Check the API address and your connection.
error.invalid_auth: Homebears did not accept this API key.
error.invalid_key_format: A Homebears API key starts with hb_.
error.nothing_selected: Choose at least one shopping list or household.
error.wrong_circle: This key cannot reach the circle of this entry.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address.
error.insecure_url: Plain http sends the API key unencrypted; use https, or http only to a server in your home network.

abort.already_configured: This circle is already set up.
abort.no_circles: This key does not reach any circle.
abort.missing_scopes: This key finds no shopping list or household in this circle to show: either there are none yet, or the key lacks the shopping, cleaning and households:read scopes.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Homebears. Check the API address and your connection.

error.nothing_selected: Choose at least one shopping list or household.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Homebears. Check the API address and your connection.
abort.invalid_auth: Homebears no longer accepts the API key. Re-authenticate the entry first.

auth_error.message: Homebears no longer accepts the API key. Set up a new one under Settings → Devices & services.

not_a_homebears_list.message: {entity_id} is not a Homebears shopping list.

not_a_homebears_household.message: {entity_id} is not a Homebears chores sensor.

household_required.message: Several households are set up; pick the household's chores sensor.

chore_not_found.message: No chore called or with the id "{chore}" in {household}.

chore_not_open_today.message: "{chore}" is not open today in {household} (already done, skipped or not due).

add_shopping_item.name: Add shopping item
add_shopping_item.description: Adds an item to a Homebears shopping list. Everyone with the list open in the app sees it at once.

entity_id.name: Shopping list
entity_id.description: The Homebears to-do list to add to.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How much, as free text (2, 500 g, 1 pack).

op_id.name: Operation id
op_id.description: Makes the call safe to repeat: Homebears applies the same id only once within 24 hours. Letters, digits and . _ : - only, at most 64.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore
complete_chore.description: Ticks off a chore. A scheduled chore completes today's open occurrence; an on-demand chore is logged as done now.

entity_id.name: Household
entity_id.description: The household's 'Chores open today' sensor. Optional when only one household is set up.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence id
occurrence_id.description: Instead of a chore: one occurrence, e.g. from the chores sensor's attributes.

credited_user_id.name: Credit to
credited_user_id.description: User id of the member who gets the points. Default: the API key's owner.
